title: Front-end collision — Toyota Corolla
description: Low-speed collision against a concrete bollard in a parking lot. Awaiting damage assessment.

damages.description: Cracked and partially detached on the left side after the impact.
Deep dent with paint damage near the latch; alignment affected.
Lens shattered, housing intact.

title: Side impact — Volkswagen Golf
description: Vehicle hit on the driver side at an intersection. Under review by the adjuster.

damages.description: Large dent and scratched paint along the full length of the panel.
Casing broken, mirror glass missing.

title: Rear-end collision — Ford Focus
description: Rear-end collision while stopped at a traffic light. Tailgate, bumper and rear lights affected; structural inspection passed and the full repair was approved by the adjuster.

damages.description: Crushed center section with damaged parking sensors.
Misaligned and no longer closing flush with the body.
Right cluster cracked, water ingress visible.

title: Windshield chip — Honda Civic
description: Customer reported a windshield chip but withdrew the claim before inspection.

damages.description: Small stone chip on the passenger side, no crack spreading.

title: Hail damage — Nissan Qashqai
description: Vehicle caught in a hailstorm while parked outdoors. Awaiting full assessment.

damages.description: Multiple dents across the roof from hailstones.
Star crack on the driver side from a hail impact.

title: Parking scrape — SEAT León
description: Long scrape found after parking in a tight street spot.

damages.description: Long scrape with paint transfer along the rear panel.

title: Flood damage — Renault Clio
description: Cabin flooded after the car was caught in a flash flood. Electronics being checked.

damages.description: Soaked interior carpeting after street flooding; mildew risk.
ECU exposed to water, multiple electrical faults logged.
Rubber seals deteriorated, allowing water ingress.

title: Animal collision — Peugeot 3008
description: Collision with a deer on a rural road at dusk. Under review.

damages.description: Grille shattered after the collision.
Radiator punctured, coolant leaking.

title: Multi-car pile-up — BMW Serie 1
description: Three-car pile-up on the motorway. Both the front and rear ends were affected; the adjuster validated the structural report and approved the complete repair before closing the claim.

damages.description: Completely destroyed, fog lights missing.
Buckled and no longer latching.

title: Garage door impact — Audi A3
description: The vehicle was scraped along the right side while exiting a garage with a partially open door; damage was limited to body panels and the repair was completed and signed off by the workshop.

damages.description: Deep gouges along both right doors, down to bare metal.

title: Duplicate report — Mazda 3
description: Claim opened by mistake; the incident was already filed under another reference, so this one was canceled.

title: Minor scuff — Kia Sportage
description: Customer decided to handle a minor cosmetic scuff out of pocket and canceled the claim.

damages.description: Light cosmetic scuff, no structural damage.
